candidates.title: Default steer id derived from current queue length can reuse a still-pending id after revocation
candidates.contract: Queue entries carry stable ids for individual pending-entry correlation and revocation; Engine id argument has a default.
candidates.actualEvidence: Pure helper calls with the independently inspected default id expression create [steer-1(second), steer-1(third)]; removeSteerItem(..., steer-1) removes both.
candidates.producerEvidence: Static Engine.enqueueSteer default expression and protocol pass-through only. No actual Engine execution or ordinary host caller omitting ids was established.
candidates.controls: Distinct host ids revoke exactly one pending entry; FIFO drain and input-array preservation pass.
limits: No UI, real active run, actual default-id allocation, protocol RPC or lost user work was reproduced.
Helpers intentionally accept caller-supplied ids; duplicate external ids alone are not a separate defect.

candidates.title: Equal opening/closing tag counts do not ensure all malformed inline-image markup is rejected
candidates.actualEvidence: Actual parseTaskWithImages accepts a closing tag before its only opening tag, returns unchanged text and hasImages false. A valid block plus the same malformed tail returns one image and leaves malformed tag text.
candidates.producerEvidence: Hand-built malformed wire only. Static Desktop encoder always emits complete opener/body/closer blocks; no ordinary encoder or transport corruption producer of the reversed ordering was established.
candidates.controls: True unbalanced opener and invalid data body throw ImageParseError; valid block parses; escaped attrs and source-order images pass.
limits: No real image decode, staged file, provider input, actual byte loss or user-visible failure was reproduced.
Fixture base64 YQ== is parser syntax data, not a claim of a decodable PNG.
Reserved literal opener rejection is an explicit existing test policy; not promoted as a new bug.
